production_runtime: No production multi-agent components were added; evaluation subagents remained development-only.

iterations.iteration: A to B: authoritative account entry
iterations.change: Added read-only backend auth options and made login render only configured guest/registration modes.
iterations.result: Removed the disabled guest CTA under the current backend config; registration remains available.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: No-account demonstration remains unavailable when the backend flag is false.

iterations.change: Added tab keyboard semantics, registration fallback on options failure, retry feedback/focus, 44x44 retry target, and localized disabled-registration error.
iterations.result: Independent critic retest passed all scoped findings; mobile 320px had no overflow.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: Screen-reader output and whole-product keyboard accessibility were not manually verified.

iterations.change: No code change during holdout evaluation.
iterations.result: Candidate did not complete a no-account demo goal. Blind judge preferred reconstructed baseline screenshots despite the disabled action because the candidate only offered account creation.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: Do not claim a task-completion win or overall UX win. Guest access is currently disabled by backend config; enabling anonymous account creation is a product/security decision outside this frontend fix.

iterations.change: Updated E2E interactions and fixtures to use the current expanded task filters, advanced planner entry, visible PlanPreview, collapsed tool details, current approval action label, and a fixed planner date.
iterations.result: The entire smoke suite passed 17/17; five failures from outdated test expectations were resolved without changing the product UI.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: The suite still uses mocked APIs and cannot establish a real browser AgentRun.

iterations.iteration: Approval conflict context 1: identify the event
iterations.change: Rendered backend-provided conflict titles and occupied intervals in the account timezone; added a disclosure for additional conflicts.
iterations.result: Independent blind judge preferred the event/time candidate over count-only context (confidence 0.98); a static simulator could read the event and interval without interaction.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: The user still had to infer the exact intersection. The first desktop/mobile simulator screenshots used isolated proposal fixtures, not a live AgentRun.

iterations.iteration: Approval conflict context 2: state the exact overlap
iterations.change: Computed the interval intersection in backend event/action-proposal services and displayed it in the approval card. Improved small secondary-text contrast, mobile navigation contrast, decision-neutral copy, and a no-execution-before-confirmation hint. Kept the existing HITL buttons and server policy.
iterations.result: A fresh blind judge preferred X, the exact-overlap candidate, over a controlled view with the same text and layout but no backend overlap fields (confidence 0.99). The single-conflict simulator marked the goal complete at 4/5 satisfaction using static screenshots. No high-severity adversarial issue was found.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: Static screenshots do not verify screen readers or a live AgentRun approval/apply journey. A four-conflict disclosure fixture is kept as a separate regression case; its first simulator run was not counted as the primary single-conflict goal.

iterations.iteration: Approval conflict context 3: preserve a safe, editable decision
iterations.change: Fail closed when approval or edit review is incomplete or has fresh conflicts; strip UI-only fields before resuming strict event-mutation tools; keep incomplete edits open; validate event intervals before submit; retain reminder targets that are temporarily absent from the selector; restore edit focus after asynchronous target loading and restore mobile navigation when the keyboard closes.
iterations.result: Conflict states expose an edit path but no approve action. Latest blind comparison preferred the exact-overlap view (X, confidence 0.78); the holdout simulator identified the conflict at 4/5 satisfaction but needed scrolling to reach controls. Follow-up findings in partial-update preview, stale event versions, and null-time editor context are fixed with regression coverage; final read-only critic recheck found no remaining scoped P1/P2.
iterations.risk_or_open_gap: The decision controls remain below the fold in the holdout screenshot and require scrolling. Evidence uses current-source mocks and static reviews; there is no live AgentRun approval/apply, human participant study, real mobile device, or screen-reader walkthrough.

overall_status: partial: auth state reflects backend truth; the scoped approval conflict context now shows backend-authored exact overlap; core no-account demo holdout failed; product-wide Agent UX remains incomplete
rollback_decision: Retain capability-driven rendering as a correctness/truthfulness fix, not as a successful solution to the holdout task. The blind comparison does not show overall task UX improvement; provide the user with the unresolved guest-access decision rather than hiding that result.
evidence_gaps: full 320/375/430 auth-options failure matrix on physical mobile devices
